full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff-petitioner filed the suit for a decree declaring the appointment of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 as directors of defendant No. 5 Bank as illegal, void and not binding on the Bank. In that suit, the plaintiff filed an application for temporary injunction with a prayer for ad interim injunction for restraining defendant Nos. 1 and 2 from performing their functions as directors of the Bank, alleging that they being not sponsors-share-holders or nominees of any sponsors-share-holders were elected illegally as directors of that Bank.
